articles.title: Telix to Participate in UBS Global Biopharma Conference

articles.summary: Telix today announces that it has joined Thera4Care, an initiative aimed at establishing an integrated, collaborative ecosystem for theranostics (therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals) to broaden patient access in Europe. The project includes 27 partners from top European academic centers, healthcare providers, industry stakeholders, and patient advocacy groups.
articles.title: Telix Joins Thera4Care with TLX400-Tx to Accelerate Translation of Next Generation FAP-Targeting Theranostics
